SELECT s.`code`, s.`market`, s.`trade_date` AS `tradeDate`, s.`total_score` AS `totalScore`, i.`name`, i.`exchange`, i.`board`, i.`industry`, s.`close` FROM `stock_score_daily` s LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = s.`code` AND i.`exchange` = s.`market` WHERE s.`adjustflag` = #{adjustFlag} AND s.`trade_date` BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND s.`total_score` IS NOT NULL
AND (s.`code` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.`code`, s.`market`, s.`trade_date`
